purpose: Development-only reality-label corpus for testing whether saju-derived features can rank positive vs negative life-event years within the same person.
core_rule: Y is real-world life events only; astrology/model outputs are forbidden from this corpus.

normalization_policy.reputation_and_legal: event_type metadata only, not primary targets
normalization_policy.unknown_rule: absence of evidence is unknown, never negative/neutral
normalization_policy.multi_label_rule: one real event may label multiple primary targets only when source text/axis supports each
assignment_priority: conservative lexical normalization from existing event description
normalization_policy.ml_usable_rule: at least one primary target assigned AND source_event_confidence != low
normalization_policy.names_are_audit_only: subject name must never be used as an ML feature
